fact_text: North Karachi is a KDA township of about 16 sectors, some with four or five sub-sectors, that the interviewee said spans roughly 8 km in diameter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: The interviewee said North Karachi, a township that began in 1970, has settlement stretching about 20 km along the main route and has become a central part of Karachi.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: The reporter described North Karachi as a VIP township with good infrastructure, and with markets, hospitals, schools and universities nearby, within one of Karachi's seven districts.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: North Karachi plot sizes run from 80 gaz to 600 gaz: 80-gaz houses sit mainly in sectors 1 to 5, while 120-gaz plots are the majority in sectors 14 and 15-B.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: As stated in the 19 Oct 2025 interview, two-bedroom apartments in North Karachi start at about PKR 20 lakh.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: As stated in the 19 Oct 2025 interview, two-bedroom DD apartments in North Karachi run from about PKR 25 lakh up to about PKR 1 crore.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: As stated in the 19 Oct 2025 interview, three-bedroom apartments in North Karachi start at about PKR 65 lakh.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: Apartment categories in North Karachi run from studio-type one-bedroom-lounge units up to four-bedroom luxury flats, according to the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: As stated in the 19 Oct 2025 interview, a vacant 120-gaz plot on a main road was quoted at about PKR 2 crore, and built 120-gaz houses on main roads at about PKR 3 crore.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: As stated in the 19 Oct 2025 interview, 400-gaz houses were quoted at about PKR 8 to 12 crore and 600-gaz houses at about PKR 18 to 25 crore, with main-road plot prices much higher.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: As stated in the 19 Oct 2025 interview, a plot on a 100-ft road in sectors 8 and 10 was quoted at about PKR 3 crore.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: Kings Builders launched Kings Dream Villas, a North Karachi housing scheme of 120-gaz plots only, where buyers build their own homes; the developer called it its first plot-only project.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: The developer said its earlier North Karachi work includes Kings Plaza, a project at Chowrangi that has been handed over and is occupied, and that the family firm's first project was also in North Karachi.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: Kings Dream Villas offers only 120-gaz plots; the developer said its other projects include 80-gaz and 200-gaz plots, while 240-gaz and 400-gaz plots are not in this scheme.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: Kings Dream Villas offers schedule-based payment plans at a higher price than one-shot payment, and one-shot buyers receive a sizeable discount, which the developer said most buyers choose.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: The interviewee said new project launches in North Karachi have fallen sharply after a period of active builder interest, citing government policy, taxes and inflation as the main reasons.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: The interviewee said North Karachi offers plots at more reasonable prices than Gulistan-e-Jauhar and Scheme 33, though buyers must check the developer's standing.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: The interviewee advised buyers to check whether a developer holds clear land title before booking, because many North Karachi areas have land litigation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)

fact_text: In North Karachi, 80-yard houses were reported to sell from PKR 60 lakh up to PKR 1.5 crore, with road-level homes at the lower end.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'North Karachi's New Real Estate Investment Options | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-10-19)
